messages:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a small regional routing change tonight: shift 8% of EU-edge traffic to APAC edge for a 2h validation window. Target: 2024-06-15 01:00 UTC. Who can pair on the rollout? Quick smoke checklist below.

Devon: I can be on deploy. I'll handle the route policy swap and watch routing tables.

Liam: I'll run smoke probes and watch latency dashboards. What TTL are we using for DNS? want short to make steps reversible.

Maya: TTL = 30s for the window. Plan: step weights 2% -> 4% -> 8% every 5m. Immediate rollback to 0% if error criteria met. Smoke checklist:
- publish policy (dry-run)
- update weight
- run latency + error probes
- tracing review
- rollback readiness

Commands for reference:
```
# preview policy publish
redwoodctl route publish --policy eu->apac-surgical --dry-run
# set weights (example)
redwoodctl route set-weight --region eu --target apac --weight 2
```

Rachel: I'll watch error budgets & traces. Please tag me at the 4% step.

Devon: ops-bot — schedule the canary steps (5m cadence) and post updates here.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary steps: 2% @01:00, 4% @01:05, 8% @01:10. Notifying #eng-platform. :white_check_mark:

Liam: Preflight quick-run: origin health ok, kv-cache warm, qps baseline steady. Probe snap:
```
EU -> /ping: 200, p50=18ms p95=120ms
APAC warm: p50=22ms p95=140ms
```

Maya: Nice. Quiet window: 30m after 8% before any expansion. Rollback triggers: 5x baseline errors OR 30% p95 latency regression vs baseline.

Rachel: Oncall at 01:05. I'll post a short status after each step. If I miss a post within 90s after a step, treat as missing and pause rollout.

Devon: Publishing policy now. Ping @Rachel @Liam when first step goes live.

deploy-bot: Policy eu->apac-surgical published (id: pol_7782). Initiating step 1 (2%) at 2401234800.

Maya: After step 3 we'll run the full smoke run: e2e cart flow + embeddings hook. Liam please run the canary scripts then.

Liam: Will do. DNS TTL pushed to 30s in CDN manifest — please confirm propagation.

Devon: TTL confirmed in CDN config. rolling.

ops-bot: Step 1 complete. Traffic at 2%. Monitors: error-rate nominal, latency nominal. Next step in 5m.

Rachel: Observing traces — tail error counts flat. :thumbsup:

Liam: Canary scripts passed 2/2 for cart flow. Proceed.

ops-bot: Step 2 complete. Traffic at 4%. Next step scheduled in 5m.

Rachel: All good so far, no regressions.

Devon: Starting step 3 (8%) now. Watching routing tables and AS path churn.

ops-bot: Step 3 complete. Traffic at 8%. Monitors stable. Quiet window begins.

Maya: Great work team. Keep this channel for any rollback signals. I'll update the runbook and mark complete after the quiet window.
